newsitem.title: FRANCE: FORECAST-French Q1 GDP seen rising 0.4 pct-survey.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-French Q1 GDP seen rising 0.4 pct-survey.

text.p: French quarter-on-quarter gross domestic product (GDP) growth in the first quarter of 1997 is expected to be 0.4 percent, according to the median forecast in a Reuter survey of 11 economists on Tuesday.
National statistics office INSEE is to release a first estimate of first quarter GDP growth on June 5, at 0645 GMT.

Contributors gave forecasts for the quarter-on-quarter change in GDP, according to the INSEE definition, which does not take account of differences in the number of working days in a quarter. There were 62 working days in the first quarter.
The table gives mean, median, high and low of the 11 individual forecasts.
